snippet.title: The Crypt of the Fallen | Procedural Dungeon Gameplay – Scars of Honor
snippet.description:
The Crypt of the Fallen 🕷️ is a procedural dungeon in Scars of Honor, where every run reshapes the layout, enemies, and challenges.

This dungeon is part of the game’s PvE content currently in development, designed to focus on replayability, decision-making, and adapting to the unknown rather than memorizing fixed paths.

Dungeons can be tackled with a party, with each attempt offering a different experience.

👉 Wishlist the game on Steam to stay updated on future news and tests: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4253010/Scars_of_Honor/
